name: What prep work should I do before basement painters arrive?

mainEntity.name: What prep work should I do before basement painters arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before painters arrive, clear all furniture, storage bins, and personal belongings at least four to five feet away from perimeter walls. Remove wall hangings, outlet faceplates, and switch covers if possible. If you plan to paint an exposed ceiling, items must be moved entirely out of the space or consolidated in the center and covered to protect against overspray. Additionally, check for signs of active moisture, leaks, or powdery white efflorescence on foundation walls, as these issues must be repaired and dried before painting begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Move furniture and storage at least five feet away from walls, clear wall decor, and identify any active moisture or peeling areas so they can be addressed before painting.
